svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Blank 270 x 420 mm, 3 mm aluminium. Front view: the face the box sits on.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Heights from the bottom edge; sideways from the centre line.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: U-bolt holes 9 mm at 29 each side, 25 and 395 up (two U-bolts).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Lug screw holes 5.5 mm at 85 each side, 67 and 353 up.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Shield screws: drill 4.2 mm and tap M5 at 117.5 each side,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 100 and 320 up (or fit M5 rivet nuts in 7 mm holes).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The box sits centred, from 80 to 340 up; mark its outline.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Deburr every hole and edge; round the corners to about 3 mm.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the box's back flat on the front face, held by four lugs;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: two V-saddles flat on the back face, one at each U-bolt.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: lay the lugs and saddles on it and look through each hole.
